traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE appear to be fully implemented: - Traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags. - The parser recognizes any non-traceability `@*` JSDoc tag as a boundary and terminates pending multi-line @story/@req values at that line. - Continuation only occurs on lines that do not start with another JSDoc tag, preserving multi-line values without including subsequent JSDoc tags. - Tests explicitly mapped to each requirement (REQ-JSDOC-TAG-COEXISTENCE, REQ-ANNOTATION-TERMINATION, REQ-JSDOC-BOUNDARY-DETECTION, REQ-CONTINUATION-LOGIC, REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES, REQ-PRESERVE-MULTILINE) are present and passing. - Documentation has been updated with a dedicated JSDoc coexistence section and examples that match the story, and the full Jest suite passes, indicating no regressions.
Based on this concrete evidence, the story is assessed as PASSED.
